New addition: [Profession: Successor to the Demon King]
“Quickly take action, Demon King! Kill all the heroes! Restore the glory of the demon race!”
Wait, did something go wrong here?
In the beginner's village, where Xia Mi spent his days farming and serving as a passer-by, he suddenly had an identity panel.
But he was just a villager in the beginner's village!
“Where is the Demon King? Where is the Demon King?”
News of the Demon King's emergence spread across the continent, and every hero who came here to defeat the Demon King could see a constant stream of monsters in the beginner's village, but never caught sight of the Demon King.
A villager from the beginner's village: Demon King? I'm just a villager. I have no idea what it is.
son-of-julius-caesar-rebuilding-rome-bus:
I wanted nothing more than an ordinary life—free from crushing debt and the endless corporate grind.
Instead, I died. And when I opened my eyes, I was in ancient Rome.
My father? Gaius Julius Caesar—the man destined to rule, or ruin, the Republic.
But history is written in blood. If I do nothing, my new family will be swept away by the coming political firestorm.
Power is survival in Rome, and I intend to survive.
Armed with modern knowledge, I will reshape the Roman Republic—through banking, insurance, industry, and new political strategies.
Rome will never be the same.
==============================================
What to Expect:
- A grounded story set in the Roman Republic (BCE)
- Technological innovation, business, military campaigns, Senate politics, and diplomacy
- Based on real history—its religions, places, and historical figures
- Smart MC using future knowledge to solve problems
- 5 chapters a week, M-F
==============================================

spartan-reincarnation:
A young man dies and is transported all the way back into Ancient Sparta. Underneath all the bravado is a now failing nation after over extension from the Peloponnesian war against Athens. Will the man save Sparta and forge it in his desired image? Or will Persia, Athens, and other city-states or empires crush them!
Contains portrayals of real life leading figures and gets to the nitty gritty of the often disgusting and disturbing life's people suffered through in Ancient Greece.
Expect a new chapter a few times a week. Total world count 30,000
sss-rank-dragon-summoning-only-i-can-sum:
Earth desecrated, humans slaughtered, and all razed to the ground—that was the destruction the devils brought in their wake, and Kendrick Skylar, one of Earth’s Awakened who had stood against them, was the last to be taken by this plague.
However, his death was not the end, but rather the beginning, as he was transmigrated to another world to restart his life, beginning as a baby.
Growing up, the sore realization of how similar this world was to his own struck him. And the plague that befell his world would come for his new one, and everything he held dear, sooner or later.
Awakening with the ability to summon SSS-rank dragons and an undead legion, he must prepare for the same fate that ended his first life to occur again.
And this time, he must be ready.
the-legend-of-futian:
In a time when the Divine Prefectures of the East Sea were in great disarray, Emperor Ye Qing and Donghuang the Great appeared to save the day. Under their rule, the prefectures united and all nations as well as their kings have been controlled. However, the legend of these two great heroes becomes altered when Emperor Ye Qing’s name is wiped from the history books after his sudden death. All statues and images of him were destroyed and his name a taboo. Only the legend of Donghuang the Great shall live on.
Fifteen years later, a young man by the name of Ye Futian begins his journey in search for his true identity. The legend of Futian was going to be one for the history books.
the-villains-survival-instruction-manual:
Court-martialed, disgraced, and abandoned by the world he once served, a former special operations commander awakens inside a novel he himself wrote.
Reborn as the doomed son of a noble family, a villain fated to die within a month.
Armed only with fractured memories and a ruthless instinct for survival, he begins drafting a private manual consisting of rules for living in a world governed by gods, bloodlines, and betrayals.
As orthodox churches tighten their grip and forgotten gods stir beneath the empire’s foundations, the academy becomes a battlefield disguised as education.
Secret orders hunt what they do not understand. Villains plot within villains. And every role he plays brings him closer to a fate he was never meant to survive.
When a sealed god begins to descend and the price of stopping it demands blood, the rules he wrote for survival are tested one final time.
to-be-yours-again:
A bet.
One scandal cost Alora Harper almost everything. She was a star student. All she ever cared about was working hard to achieve her dreams until Caden Steele popped into her life and almost ruined her. Now, she is determined to never let her guards down again. Caden Steele had always been a self-absorbed playboy but playing with Alora didn’t go as planned. Instead, it made him unable to function without her. Now, he is determined to win her back.
But it might just be too late!
to-hell-with-being-a-saint-im-a-doctor:
Yuseong, a genius doctor who made a name for himself in the medical community, considered the operating room his home. One day, he died in a traffic accident, and when he regained consciousness, he found himself in another world.
But… Saint… Holy Kingdom… Healing magic?
“I worked so hard to learn medicine, and now you’re telling me I can just touch someone and they’re healed? Oh, I’m going to lose my mind.”
tycoon-i-have-an-unlimited-modifier:
Upon acquiring an unlimited modifier, Qi Sheng didn’t hesitate to give himself a massive, top-to-bottom overhaul.
Appearance, Constitution, Intelligence, and other core stats… directly maxed to the absolute limit!
Monthly income? Max that out too!
The once-unattainable dream of a million-dollar annual salary is now effortlessly achieved with just a few taps of his finger.
Surrounded by a flock of stunning beauties, he spends his days mastering the culinary arts, working out, skiing, and photography…
It’s time to truly start enjoying life!
villain-transmigrated-as-protagonists-fa:
[Warning :- R-18 ]
Astor, an Incompetence male from the 21st century transmigrated from earth to another world in his sleep.
Now possessing the body of a minor villain in the novel, who has no job but to be cucked by the protagonist.
But there is a catch, he is the father of the Protagonist.
His very son is out there to kill his father and claim his wives and his Five Stepdaughters in his harem.

villains-in-the-apocalypse-my-kids-are-t:
The world is about to turn upside down. One minute, everyone is drowning, the next they're freezing, and who knows what else comes after that.
Kain's been reborn before the collapse. He has seen too much and heard too much. All he wants to do is relax...maybe build an empire. Before the world takes a turn for the...better? ...worse?
Well, that depends on who you ask.
A “Nurturing System” pops up on the day Kain is reborn. It tells him he has kids and that he needs to find them. THEM. Plural.
He is already wondering how to survive with evolving beasts everywhere and source energy reshaping the world. Now he has to take in three, kind of adorable, most likely insane, children.
All he can do is teach them to survive.
Just...can they be less violent? He's starting to like them.
who-designed-this-underworld-dungeon:
To survive, the unfortunate Gong Qiying, who became the lord of the Sein Dungeon, had to make his dungeon extremely “hellish”:
Doors that “cannot be opened from this side”,
treasure chests “triggering teleport traps”,
a three hundred and sixty-five mile journey from the starting point to the BOSS room with no place to rest,
monster knights with great bows on either side of a narrow bridge,
and sinister ambushes around corners.
There's also unavoidable visits to poisonous pits and hidden paths...
Additionally, well-known fighters like Isshin Ashina, the Furnace Knight, Rajang, and the Scourge Legion bring unexpected surprises!
Various unique rewards such as the Flaming Sword, Murky Hand Scythe, Rapid Slash Longsword, Sacred Oath, and Flame Empowerment will make you too happy to contain your joy!
Gong Qiying: The most important thing in my dungeon is to ensure adventurers have fun!
world-saving-plan-the-only-savior:
Worlds overlapped, and Alien Species descended.
Strange entities emerged one after another, as the shadow of evil spread wildly.
The calm of life was shattered, and Zhang Xiaoman, inside a fish's stomach, accidentally consumed a system named “World-saving Plan”.
From then on, he became the only person among all humans with Extraordinary Power.
…
Inventing an ancient oath, he established a unique methodology, Cultivated Dark Energy, founded an organization, took Control of the Transcendent, and resisted invasions.
Well, this is actually the story of how a Big Con Man bluffed his way into saving the entire world.
PS: Contains elements of the behind-the-scenes, Cthulhu mythos.
you-will-be-blessed-if-you-do-good-deeds:
— Doing good deeds brings blessings.
— If actions meet societal standards, user ‘Jeong Da-on’ will have their restrictions reduced.
Blessings for doing good deeds? Even if I was the Demon Lord in my previous life?
It’s been 19 years since I ended my tumultuous life as the Demon Lord and reincarnated on modern Earth.
I was caught by the system and forcibly turned into a Hunter. And now I have to do good deeds to regain my original abilities?
“Hmm… Beating bad guys to death counts as a good deed, right?”
That doesn’t sound too bad.
Modern society is the perfect place for a demon to thrive, after all.
young-master-is-being-jealous-again:
In her past life, Qin Ruan was deeply embroiled in a family feud, framed, and died with unfulfilled desires.
Having been reincarnated, she returned armed with a pregnancy report and made her way to the gate of the prestigious Huo Family in Capital City, one hand on her lower back.
It was rumored that Huo Sanye, the legitimate grandson of the Huo Family, was decisive and ruthless, endowed with an aloof sophistication, unpredictable mood swings, and was utterly unfeeling and heartless.
Sanye was about to take a wife, an illegitimate daughter located and brought back by the Qin Family.
This news exploded throughout Capital City!
No one believed that an illegitimate daughter could securely hold the position of the Huo Family Head's wife; everyone was waiting for their divorce.
Leveraging her reincarnated mystical abilities, Qin Ruan set up shop under Tianqiao, stirring up the major power dynamics within Capital City.
The fourth-generation golden grandson of the Huo Family even crawled out from Qin Ruan's belly.
As her true identity gradually revealed itself, no one dared to belittle her anymore.…
